name: Evernote
tagline: Long-running note app for capture, search, tasks, and cross-device notes

pricing.notes: Official Evernote plan pages checked 2026-07-30; current plan names have changed, and Starter is listed around $14.99/month in public plan references.

verdictSummary: A personal notes app with OCR/search/import is reachable, but the hard parts are migration, sync reliability, clipper UX, OCR quality, and years of user data.
coreLoopDIY: Create a Markdown/database notes app with tags, attachments, web clipper, OCR pass, and full-text search.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because all old notes, attachments, scans, and clipped pages are already there.

priorArt.name: Joplin
priorArt.desc: Mature open-source note app with sync, markdown notes, clipping, and end-to-end encryption

notes: A good example where core notes are easy but switching costs and capture depth drive retention.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Evernote (Long-running note app for capture, search, tasks, and cross-device notes). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create a Markdown/database notes app with tags, attachments, web clipper, OCR pass, and full-text search.
- Needs: desktop/mobile or web app.
- Needs: file storage.
- Needs: OCR library/API.
- Needs: search index.
- Needs: browser extension if clipping matters.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: web clipper quality; mobile apps; OCR/search maturity.
